text_1.text:
Altera Agilex 9 FPGA and SoC is an FPGA with some enhanced functions for special applications. For example, the Direct RF Series​ ​integrates industry-leading wideband data converters with sample rates up to 64Gsps and mid-band data converters with high-fidelity performance into the FPGA. Ideal for applications such as defense, radar, high-end test, and wireless solutions. Targets those applications that demand ultra-low power consumption yet require high channel density packages to address difficult size constraints. Pushing beyond the limits of mainstream programmable logic - these FPGAs provide unprecedented capabilities and optimization for their target applications.

The Direct RF Series is optimized for synthesis of complex digital, mixed-signal and DSP algorithms. Synchronous products with up to 64Gsps sample rate are available in chiplet based configurations - providing a common front-end, flexible compute, connectivity and frequency agility.

• Hardened 200G Crypto IP core
  • Supports 128-bit AES encryption/decryption
  • 64-bit MACsec IP to secure network traffic

• High-efficiency GPU engine with up to 25 tera floating point operations per second (TFLOPS)
  • Digital signal processing (DSP) performance (FP16)
• Enables design optimization capabilities to deliver significant fmax performance compared to previous generation high-end Altera FPGAs
